name: Brew at the Zoo
description: Complete any 10 quests to enter the running for Brew at the Zoo Champion. A photo, screenshot, or group verification is required for all quests.

quests.title: Find an underrated beer
quests.description: Find a beer with an Untappd rating under 3.50 that you think deserves better.
quests.proof_note: Beer photo + Untappd screenshot required.

quests.title: Find the weirdest ingredient
quests.description: Find a beer brewed with the most bizarre or unexpected ingredient on the menu.
quests.proof_note: Group decides if it qualifies.

quests.title: Recommend someone's beer of the day
quests.description: Recommend a beer that becomes someone else's favorite of the day.
quests.proof_note: The person you recommended it to must verify.

quests.title: Predict the group's favorite
quests.description: Predict a beer the entire group will love — before anyone tries it.
quests.proof_note: Group must confirm they all loved it.

quests.title: Find the funniest beer name
quests.description: Track down the beer with the most hilarious name at the festival.
quests.proof_note: Photo of the beer name required.

quests.title: Find the coolest can or tap artwork
quests.description: Find the most visually stunning can design or tap handle artwork at the festival.
quests.proof_note: Photo of the can or tap required.

quests.title: Try a new beer style
quests.description: Try a beer style you have never had before.
quests.proof_note: Photo of the beer required.

quests.title: Find the highest ABV beer
quests.description: Track down the beer with the highest alcohol by volume at the entire festival.
quests.proof_note: Photo of the beer and its ABV listing required.

quests.title: Find the lowest ABV beer
quests.description: Track down the beer with the lowest alcohol by volume at the entire festival.
quests.proof_note: Photo of the beer and its ABV listing required.

quests.title: Drink from a brewery new to you
quests.description: Try a beer from a brewery you have never visited or tried before.
quests.proof_note: Photo of the beer required.

quests.title: Drink from a brewery everyone knows
quests.description: Find a beer from a brewery that every single person in your group has had before.
quests.proof_note: Everyone in the group must confirm they know the brewery.

quests.title: Find the oldest brewery
quests.description: Research and find the oldest brewery represented at the festival.
quests.proof_note: Photo of the brewery booth or beer required.

quests.title: Find a beer that surprises you
quests.description: Find a beer that tastes completely nothing like what you expected from the description.
quests.proof_note: Photo of the beer required.

quests.title: Try a beer you'd never normally order
quests.description: Step outside your comfort zone and try a beer style or flavor you'd normally skip.
quests.proof_note: Photo of the beer required.

quests.title: Find the best beer description
quests.description: Find the beer with the most compelling, poetic, or hilarious description on the menu.
quests.proof_note: Photo of the menu description required.

quests.title: Find a beer whose ABV matches your birthday
quests.description: Find a beer whose ABV matches your birthday month/day — or gets closest.
quests.proof_note: Photo of the beer and ABV required.

quests.title: Find a beer with an unknown hop
quests.description: Find a beer brewed with a hop variety you have never heard of before.
quests.proof_note: Photo of the beer or menu listing the hop required.

quests.title: Find someone's new all-time favorite beer
quests.description: Find a beer that becomes someone in the group's new all-time favorite.
quests.proof_note: The person must declare it their new all-time favorite on the record.

quests.title: Best selfie with an animal
quests.description: Take your absolute best selfie with an animal in the frame.
quests.proof_note: Photo required.

quests.title: Recreate an animal pose
quests.description: Find an animal and perfectly recreate its pose for a side-by-side photo.
quests.proof_note: Photo of you and the animal in matching poses required.

quests.title: Best candid of a friend
quests.description: Capture the absolute best unplanned, candid photo of someone in your group.
quests.proof_note: Photo required — must be candid, not posed.

quests.title: Best unposed group photo
quests.description: Capture the best completely spontaneous, unposed group photo of the day.
quests.proof_note: Photo required — must be unposed.

quests.title: Most creative group picture
quests.description: Take the most creative, inventive group photo of the entire day.
quests.proof_note: Photo required.

quests.title: Find your group's spirit animal
quests.description: Find the one animal that perfectly represents your group as a whole and explain why.
quests.proof_note: Photo with the animal required.

quests.title: Photograph an animal doing something hilarious
quests.description: Catch an animal in the act of doing something genuinely funny on camera.
quests.proof_note: Photo required.

quests.title: Capture a National Geographic-worthy photo
quests.description: Take a photo so stunning it looks like it belongs in National Geographic.
quests.proof_note: Photo required.

quests.title: Find the hardest animal to spot
quests.description: Track down the most elusive, hidden, or hard-to-find animal at the zoo.
quests.proof_note: Photo of the animal required.

quests.title: Get a photo with a zoo employee
quests.description: Get a fun photo with a willing zoo employee.
quests.proof_note: Photo with the employee required — only if they're willing!

quests.title: Pair a beer with an animal
quests.description: Pair a specific beer with a specific animal and explain why the match is perfect. Example: 'The gorilla is definitely a pastry stout.'
quests.proof_note: Photo of the beer and animal required.

quests.title: Create a fake brewery origin story
quests.description: Invent the most ridiculous, elaborate fake origin story for a real brewery at the festival.
quests.proof_note: Perform or share it with the group.

quests.title: Caption a zoo animal as if it just drank your beer
quests.description: Take a photo of an animal and write the most perfect caption imagining it just tried your beer.
quests.proof_note: Photo with caption required.

quests.title: Write the most ridiculous tasting note
quests.description: Write the most absurd, over-the-top, pretentious, or hilarious tasting note for any beer.
quests.proof_note: Read it aloud to the group.

quests.title: Take a movie poster photo
quests.description: Stage and capture a photo that looks exactly like a movie poster.
quests.proof_note: Photo required.

quests.title: Take an album cover photo
quests.description: Stage and capture a photo that looks exactly like a music album cover.
quests.proof_note: Photo required.

quests.title: Take a meme-worthy photo
quests.description: Capture a photo so perfectly timed or framed it was born to become a meme.
quests.proof_note: Photo required.

quests.title: Create a fake beer commercial
quests.description: Perform or film a completely fake, over-the-top beer commercial for any beer at the festival.
quests.proof_note: Video or photo evidence required.

quests.title: Tell a six-word story
quests.description: Tell a complete six-word story inspired by one of your photos from today.
quests.proof_note: Photo and six-word story required.

quests.title: Find the beer you'd name a pet after
quests.description: Find the one beer at the festival whose name you'd actually give to a future pet.
quests.proof_note: Photo of the beer required.

quests.title: Find the beer that describes someone in your group
quests.description: Find the beer whose name or description most perfectly describes one specific person in your group.
quests.proof_note: Photo of the beer required — group must agree on the match.

quests.title: Let a friend choose your next beer
quests.description: Surrender all control — let another person in the group pick your next beer entirely.
quests.proof_note: Friend must confirm they chose it for you.

quests.title: Order the beer with the longest line
quests.description: Find the booth with the longest line and commit — order whatever they're pouring.
quests.proof_note: Photo of the line and beer required.

quests.title: Order a beer without reading the description
quests.description: Pick a beer completely at random — name only, no description allowed.
quests.proof_note: Group must witness you ordering blind.

quests.title: Visit a brewery you almost skipped
quests.description: Go back and visit a brewery booth you almost walked past or decided to skip.
quests.proof_note: Photo at the brewery booth required.

quests.title: Try a beer another group recommends
quests.description: Ask another group of strangers for a recommendation and actually try what they suggest.
quests.proof_note: Photo with the beer required.

quests.title: Convince someone to try a beer they wouldn't order
quests.description: Successfully talk someone in your group into trying a beer completely outside their comfort zone.
quests.proof_note: The person must confirm you convinced them.

quests.title: Find the perfect beer for your secret pick
quests.description: Find the single most perfect beer at the festival for the person you secretly picked.
quests.proof_note: Your secret pick must confirm it was perfect for them.

quests.title: Capture a genuine reaction
quests.description: Photograph someone's completely genuine, unposed reaction to trying a beer.
quests.proof_note: Candid photo required — no posing.

quests.title: Get everyone cheering in one photo
quests.description: Get every single person in the group raising their glass in one perfect cheers photo.
quests.proof_note: Group photo with everyone cheering required.

quests.title: Create a new inside joke
quests.description: Create a brand new inside joke that gets used at least three times throughout the day.
quests.proof_note: Group must confirm the joke was used at least three times.

quests.title: Best golden-hour photo
quests.description: Capture the most beautiful golden-hour or warm-light photo of the day.
quests.proof_note: Photo required.

quests.title: Best action shot
quests.description: Capture the best action shot of the day — movement, energy, life in motion.
quests.proof_note: Photo required.

quests.title: Funniest accidental photo
quests.description: Submit the funniest completely accidental photo you took today.
quests.proof_note: Photo required — must be genuinely accidental.

quests.title: Most artistic beer photo
quests.description: Take the most artistic, intentional, beautifully composed photo of a beer.
quests.proof_note: Photo required.

quests.title: Coolest reflection, silhouette, or creative angle
quests.description: Capture a stunning photo using a reflection, silhouette, or unexpected creative angle.
quests.proof_note: Photo required.

quests.title: Capture the happiest moment of the day
quests.description: Photograph the single most joyful, happy moment of the entire day.
quests.proof_note: Photo required.

quests.title: Entire group rates one beer 10/10
quests.description: Find a beer so perfect that every single person in the group gives it a 10 out of 10.
quests.proof_note: Every group member must confirm their 10/10 rating.

quests.title: Make another group laugh
quests.description: Do something so funny that a completely different group of strangers genuinely laughs.
quests.proof_note: Photo or video evidence required.

quests.title: Receive free brewery swag
quests.description: Walk away with free swag — a sticker, shirt, glass, hat, or anything — from a brewery.
quests.proof_note: Photo with the swag required.

quests.title: Discover a brewery everyone wants to visit
quests.description: Find a brewery so impressive that every single person in the group commits to visiting it in person.
quests.proof_note: Every group member must confirm they want to visit.

quests.title: Recreate a famous painting
quests.description: Recreate a recognizable, famous painting as a group photo — composition, poses, and all.
quests.proof_note: Side-by-side recreation photo required.

quests.title: Capture the Yearbook Cover Photo
quests.description: Take the single photo so perfect, so iconic, so utterly you — it becomes the official Yearbook Cover.
quests.proof_note: Photo required. Group votes to confirm it's cover-worthy.
